description: Lists open times on someone's Meetful booking link (meetful.com/<name>), as exact UTC instants and in the owner's time zone, with the meeting lengths and any questions the page asks. No sign-in needed.

days.description: How many days to look across, 1 to 30. Default 7.

from.description: The first day to look at, YYYY-MM-DD in the owner's calendar. Default: today.

link.description: The booking link, or just the name in it: "meetful.com/jack" or "jack".

minutes.description: How long, when the page offers more than one length.

name: find_times
title: Find open times
